output.one_liner: Twenty is an open-source, self-hostable CRM platform where teams define custom data models and workflows in TypeScript, also available as a cloud service.

auth.notes: API uses bearer token authentication (static API keys); OAuth also supported for external applications acting on behalf of users.

evidence.snippet: Create an API key in Settings → Developers → API → + Create key. Copy it immediately
For OAuth-based access external apps acting on behalf of users, see OAuth.

access.notes: Free 30-day cloud trial without credit card required; free open-source self-hosting alternative available.

evidence.snippet: Start your free trial today without credit card.
Pick 7 days without card. Both include full access — unlimited contacts, email integration, custom objects, API.
Twenty can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your data and deployment.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 100 requests per minute; batch operations up to 60 records per call; GraphQL also supports batch upsert.

evidence.snippet: REST and GraphQL APIs generated from your workspace schema.
Core API CRUD on records: People, Companies, Opportunities, your custom objects.
Rate limits Limit Value Requests 100 per minute Batch size 60 records per call
Get notified when records change — HTTP POST to your endpoint on every create, update, or delete.
Every Cloud workspace ships with a native MCP server. Connect your AI assistant via OAuth and it can read and write your CRM data.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free access, well-documented REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks enabled, and Composio toolkit with 23 tools already published.

overview_evidence.snippet: a production-ready CRM you can reshape as you go.
Build apps in TypeScript, connect your tools through APIs, and host Twenty yourself.

unknown_reasons.mcp: Official MCP server confirmed to ship with Cloud workspaces, but no public repository URL provided in documentation pages.
